plugins.name: multi-agent-hub
plugins.description: MCP-based multi-agent dispatch hub. A Master agent decomposes work, dispatches subtasks in parallel to CLI workers, isolates each worker in its own git worktree, and verifies results in a Docker sandbox before merging. Ships the agent-hub MCP server plus the multi-agent-dispatch skill. Run install.ps1 once after installing to set up Python dependencies and detect worker executables.
